newsitem.title: JAMAICA: Canadian woman, 74, busted for drugs in Jamaica.
newsitem.headline: Canadian woman, 74, busted for drugs in Jamaica.

text.p: A 74-year-old Canadian woman on Thursday pleaded guilty to drug possession charges in a Montego Bay court after 32 pounds (14.5 kg) of hashish oil was discovered in her suitcase. She was fined J$100,000 (US$2,857) and ordered deported.
Mary Dukeman of Vancouver, Canada, was arrested on Sunday at the Montego Bay aiport after her luggage was searched and the hash oil was discovered in two sealed plastic pipes.
She pleaded guilty to possession, dealing and attempting to export illegal drugs. Her attorney successfully pleaded with the court not to sentence her to prison.

Dukeman said she was approached by a group of men who asked her to export the drug to a contact in Montreal. She told the court she refused, but they somehow managed to place the pipes in her suitcase.
